evidence.title: Sorry, Claude. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Sorry, Claude
summary: Paid comparison of ChatGPT 6-Astra vs Claude Fable-5.1 that picks ChatGPT as the winner, with where-and-how sections.
description: An instalment of the How to AI newsletter comparing two freshly released models — ChatGPT 6-Astra and Claude Fable-5.1 — and giving a verdict: ChatGPT won. The outline covers where and how to use each model plus a reusable "One Prompt". The full text is for paid subscribers.
